thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGE to oncall-sre — noticing sustained high p95 and drop in tokens/sec for eu-embeddings (api/v1/embed) since 1870001234. p95 ~1.6s, baseline ~0.4s. No spike in 5xxs. Paging oncall.
maria: ack — I'm on. Pulling traces and queue metrics.
lee: ack. grabbing gpu pool and autoscaler logs.
infra: autoscaler shows repeated launch failures for eu-pool due to quota and a handful of instances stuck in PROVISIONING.
cloud-support: ticket CLOUD-8420 opened (quota_xregion). provider response: investigating, ETA for quota decision 20-40m.
maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable ingress prefix/KV cache, 2) enable region-fallback to eu->us-west for non-SLA tenants, 3) circuit-breaker for very long requests (>60s) to avoid kernel stalls. Starting step 1 now.
deploy-bot: Config change applied: /configs/embeddings/eu/prefix_cache = true (rev: ec-20260316-11). Rollout in progress.
lee: prefix cache flipped — repeated-prefix load shows improvement, p95 trending down to ~1.1s.
maria: prepping region-fallback rule. We'll tag tenants with sla_level != "premium" for fallback up to 25% to us-west cluster. Command: 
```
redwood route split embed-eu --policy fallback_non_premium=25
```
Applying.
deploy-bot: Traffic-split created: {eu:75, us-west:25} for non-premium subset.
infra: queue depth dropping. However, a few premium customers still seeing elevated p95 due to very large context windows hitting KV miss storms.
maria: applying short-term per-request size cap for non-paid tiers: max_context_length = 32768 tokens.
product-lead: please draft status page text and customer notes. Focus language on mitigation and ETA, mention dedicated customers can get priority support.
cs-lead: preparing templated message to affected accounts and a live bridge offer for any enterprise customers.
status-bot: Draft status entry (preview):
"Summary: We are investigating increased latency for embedding requests in the EU region. Mitigations (caching, temporary region-fallback, request caps) are active and improving performance. Impact: Elevated p95 and reduced throughput for some customers. ETA: 20-45 minutes for normalization, dependent on cloud quota decisions."
product-lead: good. Add "If you are on a dedicated plan and experiencing issues, please contact support with the priority tag and we'll open a dedicated channel." then publish.
status-bot: Posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1870001234 — initial update live.
cloud-support: provider has queued quota increase request. Estimated approval in ~22m, provisioning ~8-12m after.
lee: monitoring traces, isolating heavy traces that caused kernel stalls. Added temp circuit-breaker to reject requests >60s for non-paid tiers.
maria: region-fallback + prefix cache steady p95 ~0.9s overall, premium paths still ~0.7-1.0s. Good trend.
cs-lead: sending targeted note to top affected customers with ETA and mitigation summary. Template used: 
"Hi <customer>,
We detected elevated embedding latency in the EU region beginning at <time>. We have applied mitigations (caching, temporary regional routing, request caps). Expected return to normal within ~30-45 minutes subject to cloud quota. If you'd like a live bridge, reply and we'll escalate.
— Redwood Support"
infra: cloud quota approved at 1870003000; new instances provisioning now. Expected join in ~9-11m.
deploy-bot: Emergency rules remain in place until capacity verified.
maria: preparing rollback plan: 1) reduce us-west fallback by 5% steps, 2) remove non-paid caps, 3) disable circuit-breaker for paid plans, 4) monitor 10m windows.
lee: new nodes joining at 1870003600 (first wave). Observed capacity relieving queue, p95 dropping to baseline.
infra: all requested nodes online at 1870003780. Autoscaler healthy and backfills succeed.
maria: initiating controlled rollback. Reducing fallback to 15% -> 5% -> 0% in 3 steps.
deploy-bot: Traffic-split adjusted accordingly; final split eu:100 for primary service.
lee: removing emergency request caps for paid customers. Non-paid caps will remain for 10 more minutes as a safety buffer.
product-lead: great. Please prepare brief post-incident summary for leadership: timeline, root causes (quota + provisioning delays leading to kernel/backlog), mitigations, and recommended follow-ups (permanent quota bump, autoscaler alerting on soft-fail, runbook update).
cs-lead: closing customer messages now with a summary and timeline. Offering credits for affected customers per policy.
status-bot: Posted update: performance restored, mitigations removed for paid tiers, postmortem to follow.
IncidentBot: Incident resolved. Status: resolved. Duration: ~41 minutes. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1870001234 :white_check_mark:
maria: handing to lee for 30m watch. I'll draft postmortem and runbook patches. Thanks all for fast coordination :clap:
